description: This file defines the AppEnv class that provides an interface to load environment variables from a .env file using the flutter_dotenv package. It includes a static method to load the environment configuration, handling the case where the .env file may not be present.

classes.name: AppEnv
classes.description: A wrapper class that loads environment variables from a .env file for the app.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Asynchronously attempts to load environment variables from a .env file bundled with the app; handles missing file gracefully.

calls: print('AppEnv: .env not found or failed to load. Proceeding without it. Error: $e')
